request.objective: Start at https://www.qatarairways.com/. Find the weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways.

response.result:
Qatar Airways’ Economy baggage allowance varies by route and fare type:

- **Carry-on:** 1 piece up to **7 kg (15 lb)**. For flights to or from Brazil, Economy passengers may carry 1 piece up to **10 kg (22 lb)**.
- **Checked baggage on flights to/from Africa or the Americas:** **Economy Lite** includes 1 piece up to **23 kg (50 lb)**; **Classic, Convenience, and Comfort** include 2 pieces up to **23 kg (50 lb) each**.
- **Checked baggage on all other destinations:** **Lite: 20 kg (44 lb); Classic: 25 kg (55 lb); Convenience: 30 kg (66 lb); Comfort: 35 kg (77 lb).**
